subject.title: Memory dreaming run pegs the gateway event loop for ~10 min until killed; short-term recall store can never persist (2026.6.9, reproduces on unmodified dist)

question: Should maintainers accept and inspect the reporter's macOS process samples as enough to route a targeted performance fix, or require a current-main live reproduction first?
rationale: The issue is credible and reproduced on the latest release, but source inspection does not yet isolate whether the hot path is session ingestion, recall repair/writeback, plugin-state scanning, report writing, or narrative scheduling.

options.title: Inspect samples first
options.body: Ask for the three process samples and use them to identify the exact current-main frame before promoting a repair lane.

options.title: Require live current-main repro
options.body: Keep the issue blocked until maintainers or Crabbox can reproduce the late-run peg on current main with a long-lived workspace shape.

options.title: Route broader pressure fix only
options.body: Defer this issue behind the related managed-dreaming pressure/backoff PR, accepting the risk that the recall-store rebuild loop remains distinct.

recommendation.title: Inspect samples first
recommendation.body: Ask for the three process samples and use them to identify the exact current-main frame before promoting a repair lane.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent hardening and release history touches the memory-core dreaming code path and the affected release SHAs.
